response.source: K. J. Blow and D. Wood, IEEE J. Quantum Electron. 25, 2665 (1989); the constants 12.2 fs and 32 fs are the ones in common use for fused silica

ramanFraction.source: Blow-Wood / Agrawal, Nonlinear Fiber Optics: fR = 0.18 for fused silica; Lin and Agrawal (2006) give 0.245 with the boson peak

anisotropicFraction.source: anisotropic share of the Raman response (Lin and Agrawal fb + fc = 0.25), from the measured depolarisation of the Raman spectrum
